g.text: Below 1× = fewer calls; above 1× = more calls. Example: 0.8× means 20% fewer calls, not a measured speedup.

g.text: Leaf hashing only; upper-tree calls are common to all modes. Hollow green squares: T253 uses standard SHA-256.

g.text: Counts include each implementation’s padding and domain separation. SIMD does not change counts. Lines connect sampled widths.
